opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and uranium miners as safe-haven and energy-transition plays
opportunities.rationale: Gold bid on geopolitical risk; WA exploration pipeline (Forrestania, Gateway, Manhattan) supports sector; uranium at 7.5% grade (Infini) offers long-term optionality

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on oil-exposed energy majors on US$100 oil
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict sustains premium; Santos gas disruption adds domestic supply risk premium
NSW power shortfall and data-centre buildout create structural demand for generation and transmission

defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-hike fears compress NIMs; iron ore in structural downtrend; recession narrative weighs on credit

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim consumer discretionary and REIT allocations
defensive_moves.rationale: Business conditions weakest since pandemic; home buyer sentiment at new low; NZ crash signals regional contagion risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash / short-duration bonds as hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA policy uncertainty and oil volatility elevate tail risk; 'war on equities' narrative (#44) suggests further downside

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to test lower supports as oil-driven inflation fears force RBA hawkish repricing. Banks and miners lead declines. Gold and energy provide relative strength. Volatility elevated on Iran headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: If RBA prioritises inflation over growth, a shallow recession is probable within 6–9 months. Iron ore structural weakness caps materials recovery. Gold, uranium, and energy infrastructure offer multi-year structural themes. Housing correction may extend into 2027.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (next meeting)
China iron ore import data and trade policy vs Trump
Q3 business conditions and CPI print
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
